Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
WotC just finished polishing off an interactive ad for Netrunner:

URL:http://www.wizards.com/Netrunner/Webrunner/Welcome.html

but still can't seem to put even a basic card list or FAQ together
for the VtES web page:

URL:http://www.wizards.com/VTES/Welcome.html

#define RANT

When is WotC going to *start* supporting VTES? When Ancient Hearts
comes out? (sure).

With a little spare time <g> and no renumeration, I've managed to keep
track of all the rulings (even the wrong ones) and card lists (created
by other net.persons without renumeration) and wrap the whole lot under
a single search engine.

WotC simply cuts the text out of a magazine advertisement and pastes it
into a single, non-interactive web page. I'm awed. Makes me eager to
see how much time they put into playtesting Ancient Hearts.

#undef RANT
